    A twisted multiplicative basis from a zero-detecting lift #

    Let L be a lift of the arrows of the ray category of a split basic distributive algebra B whose path values vanish exactly on zero ray paths, and such that parallel paths with the same nonzero value have proportional values. Choosing one path for each nonzero ray, the values form a twisted multiplicative basis of B over the (small model of the) ray category (SplitBasicData.mulBasisOfLift; BGRS 2.9–2.10).
